```ts
import { env } from "zttp:env";
import { parallel } from "zttp:io";

structural AppProof<T> = Proof<T, "state_isolated" | "no_secret_leakage" | "canonical">;

export function handler(req: Request): AppProof<Response> {

    () => env("APP_NAME"),

}
```
